name: Spatial Pattern Uniformity and Periodicity
definition: The degree to which structural elements are arranged in a consistent, predictable, and repeating spatial pattern with uniform spacing and alignment.

name: Feature Elongation
definition: The degree to which individual structural elements or particles are stretched or extended in one primary dimension, appearing needle-like, rod-like, or fibrous.

name: Feature Occupancy Density
definition: The extent to which distinct structural elements or particles fill the available image area, reflecting both their concentration and the proportion of space they occupy.

name: Surface Irregularity and Texture
definition: The degree of texture, irregularity, and non-smoothness present on visible surfaces or along the boundaries of distinct features.

name: Collinear Fiber Alignment Duplicate
definition: Redundant parallel alignment measure of elongated fibers.

name: Particle Aggregation
definition: The extent to which individual particles or primary structural units are clustered or fused together to form larger, composite structures.

name: Fiber Alignment
definition: The degree to which elongated fibrous structures are oriented parallel to each other within the image plane.

name: Surface Texture
definition: The presence and prominence of fine-scale patterns, striations, or irregularities on the surface of individual features.

name: Feature Isolation
definition: The degree to which individual features or structures appear distinct and separated from other features or the background.

name: Shadow Sharpness
definition: This concept measures the degree of distinctness and crispness of shadow boundaries present in the image.

name: Sidewall Verticality
definition: This concept quantifies how close to perfectly perpendicular to the substrate the sidewalls of etched or grown features are.

name: Layer Interface Definition
definition: This concept measures the clarity and abruptness of the boundaries between distinct material layers or regions.

name: Particle Size Homogeneity
definition: This concept quantifies the uniformity in the size of individual particles or discrete features present in the image.

name: Feature Angularity/Curvature
definition: The degree to which dominant features are characterized by sharp angles and straight lines versus smooth, continuous curves.

name: Surface Protrusions
definition: The extent to which the surface of a primary feature is covered by numerous small, pointed, or rod-like outgrowths.

name: Feature Connectivity
definition: The extent to which discrete features are physically linked or merged to form a continuous network or larger structure.

name: Feature Prominence and Slenderness
definition: This concept quantifies the degree to which features protrude or recede from the surface, and their relative slenderness or uprightness.

name: Pore Shape Uniformity
definition: This concept quantifies the consistency of the two-dimensional shape of individual pores within a porous structure.

name: Feature Orientation Cohesion
definition: This concept measures the degree to which elongated features maintain a consistent directional alignment across the image.

name: Feature Edge Clarity
definition: This concept quantifies the visual distinctness and abruptness of boundaries between features and their surrounding material or background.
